Where Arrests and Police Incidents Happen in Chapel Hill

Each map shows where records were concentrated. Brighter, redder areas mean more records packed close together. You can zoom and drag every map.

Arrests are people arrested by Chapel Hill police. Incidents are police-recorded events, which include things like trespassing, information reports, EMS assists and domestic disturbances, so the incident maps show police activity, not only crime.

Data sources: arrests from Town of Chapel Hill Open Data, “Police Arrests Made”. Incidents: add your incidents source here.

What was removed: records at the Chapel Hill Police Department (828 Martin Luther King Jr Blvd), where many reports are logged, were taken out so they would not hide the pattern elsewhere. Incidents with no real address, and records with missing or invalid coordinates, were also removed.
